name: hyperframes-creative
desc: Non-animation creative direction for HyperFrames videos. Use for design spec (frame.md / design.md) handling, palettes, typography, narration, beat planning, audio-reactive visuals, composition patterns, and brand / style decisions. For atomic motion patterns and scene blueprints, use `hyperframes-animation`.
desc-zh: HyperFrames 视频的非动画创意指导。用于设计规格（frame.md / design.md）处理、色板、排版、解说、节拍规划、音频响应视觉、构图模式与品牌/风格决策。原子级动效模式与场景蓝图请用 `hyperframes-animation`。
author: HeyGen
